svg.title: Dragon Database Swordmaw Logo and Font Concepts
svg.desc: Four Swordmaw developments with matching app font families: Prime with Grenze, Flame with Grenze Gotisch, Regalia with Metal Mania, and Greatblade with Pirata One.

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Swordmaw family · Four wordmarks with reusable font families

svg.title: Dragon Database — DB Swordmaw Prime
svg.desc: A silver-and-black crossed-sword dragon DB emblem paired with black Dragon Database lettering based on Grenze at weight 900. The lettering is outlined for consistent artwork; the matching font family is included for live application text.
svg.metadata: Wordmark family: Grenze; weight: 900; original font file: fonts/grenze/Grenze-Black.ttf

g.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Roomier DB counters and a sharper dragon profile.
Matching font files and licenses included
